description: This PHP file defines the SaveLeaveTypeController class within the OrangeHRM project. The controller manages the preparation of Vue.js components for editing or creating leave types based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the HTTP request.

classes.name: SaveLeaveTypeController
classes.description: A controller class for handling leave type save/edit operations, extending AbstractVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares a Vue component ('leave-type-edit' or 'leave-type-save') depending on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request, and sets it for rendering.
